title: Security Analyst roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen your security analyst expertise, build professional habits, and create a showcase portfolio. Focuses on best practices, advanced tooling, and job-ready deliverables.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify core networking and Linux knowledge essential for security work.

milestones.title: Networking fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can explain TCP/IP, subnets, and common protocols and capture traffic with Wireshark.

tasks.title: Read OSI model overview
tasks.description: Study the OSI layers and TCP/IP model on MDN or Cisco docs.

tasks.title: Watch Wireshark capture tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official Wireshark video to capture and filter packets.

tasks.title: Capture traffic on home network
tasks.description: Use Wireshark to record 5 minutes of traffic and identify HTTP vs HTTPS flows.

tasks.title: Summarize common ports
tasks.description: Write a one-page cheat sheet of top 20 ports and their services.

milestones.title: Linux Essentials
milestones.outcome: You can navigate the command line, manage files, and use basic security tools on Linux.

tasks.title: Complete Linux basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the introductory Linux module covering file permissions and navigation.

tasks.title: Install a virtual Ubuntu VM
tasks.description: Set up Ubuntu in VirtualBox and take a screenshot of the terminal prompt.

tasks.title: Practice grep and awk
tasks.description: Search system logs for failed SSH attempts using grep and format output with awk.

tasks.title: Configure sudo for a new user
tasks.description: Create a non-root user and grant limited sudo rights, then test with a command.

tasks.title: Reflect on Linux security posture
tasks.description: Write a brief note on hardening steps you could apply to the VM.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop expertise in log analysis, SIEM usage, and incident response processes.

milestones.title: Log analysis
milestones.outcome: You can parse system and application logs to identify suspicious activity.

tasks.title: Read Elastic common schema docs
tasks.description: Study the ECS fields on Elastic documentation to understand standard log structure.

tasks.title: Ingest syslog into Elastic stack
tasks.description: Follow the Elastic quick-start guide to ship syslog from your Linux VM into Elasticsearch.

tasks.title: Create a Kibana dashboard
tasks.description: Build a simple dashboard visualizing login failures and sudo usage over time.

tasks.title: Write a log-parsing script
tasks.description: Use Python to extract IP addresses from auth.log and output a CSV.

tasks.title: Reflect on false positives
tasks.description: Document two examples where normal activity looked suspicious and how you would tune filters.

milestones.title: SIEM tools
milestones.outcome: You can configure alerts and queries in a SIEM platform to detect threats.

tasks.title: Watch Splunk fundamentals 1
tasks.description: Complete the first free Splunk e-learning module on Splunk.com.

tasks.title: Install Splunk Free on VM
tasks.description: Set up Splunk Free on your Ubuntu VM and index sample log files.

tasks.title: Create a basic detection search
tasks.description: Write a Splunk SPL query that flags more than 5 failed logins within 2 minutes.

tasks.title: Set up an email alert
tasks.description: Configure Splunk to send an email when the detection search fires.

tasks.title: Connect with Splunk community
tasks.description: Join the Splunk Answers forum and read three recent incident-response threads.

milestones.title: Incident response basics
milestones.outcome: You can follow a structured response workflow from detection to remediation.

tasks.title: Read NIST IR Playbook overview
tasks.description: Study the NIST 800-61 Rev.2 incident response lifecycle on NIST.gov.

tasks.title: Draft a simple IR run-book
tasks.description: Create a one-page run-book for handling a phishing email incident.

tasks.title: Simulate a phishing alert
tasks.description: Generate a mock phishing email in your lab and apply the run-book steps.

tasks.title: Document evidence collection steps
tasks.description: List the commands and logs you would gather for a compromise investigation.

tasks.title: Connect with IR professionals
tasks.description: Attend a free webinar on incident response hosted by SANS or similar org.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate real-world security analyst capabilities.

milestones.title: Home lab logging setup
milestones.outcome: You can showcase a fully instrumented lab with centralized log collection and visualizations.

tasks.title: Design lab architecture diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a diagram showing VM, syslog, Elasticsearch, and Splunk components.

tasks.title: Deploy log forwarders on all VMs
tasks.description: Install Filebeat on each VM and point to Elasticsearch.

tasks.title: Create three detection dashboards
tasks.description: Build Kibana dashboards for authentication, network traffic, and file integrity events.

tasks.title: Write a project README
tasks.description: Document setup steps, tools used, and key findings in a GitHub README.

tasks.title: Share project on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Post a short summary with screenshots and a link to the repo.

milestones.title: CTF incident report
milestones.outcome: You can produce a professional incident report that narrates detection, analysis, and remediation.

tasks.title: Select a recent CTF challenge
tasks.description: Choose a publicly available CTF scenario that includes log files and alerts.

tasks.title: Analyze provided logs
tasks.description: Use your log-analysis scripts to identify the breach timeline.

tasks.title: Write a formal incident report
tasks.description: Structure the report with executive summary, timeline, impact, and recommendations.

tasks.title: Create supporting visualizations
tasks.description: Generate charts in Kibana or Splunk that illustrate key events.

tasks.title: Get feedback from peers
tasks.description: Post the report in a security forum and incorporate constructive comments.

milestones.title: Detection rule set
milestones.outcome: You can deliver a curated set of SIEM detection rules for common threats.

tasks.title: Research MITRE ATT&CK techniques
tasks.description: Identify five high-impact techniques relevant to enterprise environments.

tasks.title: Write SPL queries for each technique
tasks.description: Create Splunk searches that detect the selected ATT&CK techniques.

tasks.title: Test rules against lab data
tasks.description: Run each query on your home lab logs and note false-positive rates.

tasks.title: Document rule metadata
tasks.description: For each rule, write a description, severity, and remediation steps.

tasks.title: Publish rule set on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a repository with the queries and documentation, and add a license.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Learn advanced topics, refine habits, and prepare for job or client work.

milestones.title: Threat intelligence integration
milestones.outcome: You can enrich alerts with external threat feeds and produce actionable intel briefs.

tasks.title: Read MISP quick-start guide
tasks.description: Study the open-source MISP documentation on threat-share platforms.

tasks.title: Set up a free MISP instance
tasks.description: Deploy MISP using Docker and import a public feed.

tasks.title: Correlate SIEM alerts with MISP
tasks.description: Create a Splunk lookup that tags alerts with known malicious IOCs.

tasks.title: Write a weekly intel brief
tasks.description: Summarize top three IOCs observed in your lab and recommended mitigations.

tasks.title: Connect with a threat intel group
tasks.description: Join a free Slack or Discord community focused on threat intel and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Advanced incident response
milestones.outcome: You can lead a full-scale incident handling process, including containment and post-mortem.

tasks.title: Study Volatility memory analysis tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the free Volatility 3 guide to analyze a memory dump.

tasks.title: Analyze a sample memory image
tasks.description: Download a public malware memory image and extract process list and network connections.

tasks.title: Update run-book with memory steps
tasks.description: Add memory-analysis procedures to your existing IR run-book.

tasks.title: Conduct a tabletop exercise
tasks.description: Simulate a ransomware incident with a colleague and walk through the updated run-book.

tasks.title: Reflect on lessons learned
tasks.description: Write a short debrief noting gaps and improvements for future incidents.

milestones.title: Job/client readiness
milestones.outcome: You can present your portfolio, articulate your process, and interview confidently for analyst roles.

tasks.title: Polish LinkedIn profile with keywords
tasks.description: Add the key skills, project links, and a concise headline to attract recruiters.

tasks.title: Prepare a 5-minute pitch
tasks.description: Craft a short narrative that explains your background, projects, and value proposition.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Run through common analyst interview questions and receive feedback.

tasks.title: Review resume against job postings
tasks.description: Match your experience to at least three analyst job descriptions and adjust bullet points.

tasks.title: Attend a virtual security meetup
tasks.description: Join a free online meetup, ask a question, and network with professionals.
